items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: We broke Duke's record, Jimmie Lunceford's record, Basie's record.

ctx.x: I'll tell you afterwhile. Anyway, when we opened out there, we broke everybody's record. We broke Duke's record, Jimmie Lunceford's record, Basie's record. We had more people than any band who ever walked in that place.
